text:
Nia: Got the pen-test appendix. Key findings: SSRF -> metadata service (high), mis-scoped service role allowing token export (medium), and noisy audit logs missing for some read-only endpoints. Need a readroom/runbook for retest. Proposing pt-813 on 2026-07-12 01:00-04:00 UTC. Can we confirm?
Omar: Window ok. Immediate blocker: metadata SSRF requires a proof-of-fix before retest. We should capture instance metadata snapshots and lock service role changes.
Beck: For evidence exchange, I prefer ephemeral roles with tight session tags + CloudTrail filters instead of presigned uploads. We get better accountability that way.
Taylor: Counterpoint: some vendors want to pull large logs; presigned URLs are easier and avoid cross-account sts complexity. Maybe hybrid: allow presigned for bulk artifacts and ephemeral role for sensitive keys.
infra-bot: Auto-ticket PT-813 created for SSRF remediation assigned to @Omar.
security-bot: Evidence tag attached: pt-813-ssrf. Retest request link: https://go.redwood.ai/pt-813-request
Nia: Hybrid approach sounds fine. Action items: create pt-evidence-us-east key (no access to prod kms keys), create short-lived pt-access role with conditions (PrincipalTag and SourceIp), and prepare manifest format.
Omar: I'll lock role changes via change-control flag and snapshot IAM role policies. Plan: hold privileged role edits from 24h prior to 24h after window. Will post the change ticket.
Beck: Manifest spec: CSV lines: sha256, size, s3_path, signed_by, timestamp. Simple and parseable. Also include kms_key_id metadata for each encrypted object.
Taylor: For presigned uploads use presign-service with upload TTL 3h and server-side encryption using pt-evidence-key. No migration/rewrap allowed.
Nia: Sample assume-role policy for assessors (one-liner): {"Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*","arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/pt-evidence-us-east"]} + Condition: StringEquals aws:PrincipalTag/assessor=true and IpAddress for vendor range.
Omar: Add kms:GenerateDataKey only if vendor signs off they need to encrypt test payloads. Otherwise deny. Also require MFA via Condition Bool aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true for human sessions.
Beck: Audit checklist: 1) CloudTrail snapshot (management & data events) 2) STS AssumeRole logs exported 3) Proxy access logs 4) KMS key metadata JSON 5) S3 object-lock metadata. I'll prepare an export script.
Nia: Please avoid rotating pt-evidence-key during the retention window. infra: can you set a rotation-suspend tag?
Omar: Yes. I'll set rotation hold and create a rollback playbook. Also will create a read-only KMS metadata dump: key state, rotationEnabled, aliases, key policy.
infra-bot: Notice: dedicated-test-cluster reserved for 2026-07-12 01:00-04:00 UTC.
Taylor: Ops note: We'll throttle vendor load and isolate test models on the dedicated cluster. DB writes are blocked, and we will route traffic through a request-fence for observability.
Nia: Evidence retention: keep artifacts for 120 days (longer for SSRF related) in GOVERNANCE mode with object-lock. Tag manifest with retention expiry.
Beck: Also capture ephemeral token IDs and include them in manifest (sts:AssumeRole ARN and session name) so auditors can trace usage.
Omar: Action items: @Omar rotation hold + IAM snapshot + key creation, @Beck manifest + audit scripts, @Taylor presign-service + cluster isolate, @Nia vendor coordination + NDA confirmation. Please ack.
Beck: Ack. Will post script gist in thread.
Taylor: Ack. Creating ticket INF-901 for presign hooks.
Omar: Ack. Change ticket CHG-4451 created for role freeze and rollback playbook.
security-bot: Reminder: include evidence tag in all ticket titles (pt-813-ssrf).
Nia: Great work. Once all done I'll lock the retest window and publish runbook to confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pt-813-runbook
Nia: (later) All items green. Retest locked. Uploading summary and manifest link.
